record: dev.11 release baseline: fix for the typed-floor/typed-tier mismatch that made the editor reject every generation on dev.10 (VSIX 1.53.0)

classifier.policy: weights frozen; precision target 0.95, minimum routed decisions 3 (unchanged from dev.9)

defect.symptom: BAS: "MockGen generated an invalid validated result" after T3, on every generation where the fine-tuned tier accepted any value
defect.cause: typedFloor counted every row of a typed-floor property; tiers.typed subtracted the cells the fine-tuned tier overwrote. The editor IPC validator requires the causes to sum to tiers.typed. Travel: 759 vs 715 (difference 44 = model slots).
defect.whyTestsMissed: the editor fixture used hand-made numbers; no package test checked the sum with model > 0; no check ran a real package result through the editor validator
defect.fix: both statistics computed in one pass over the same cells
defect.regression: value-tiers.test.ts asserts the sum with model > 0 (failed before the fix, passes after); evaluation/editor-contract-check.mjs runs real generations through the editor worker mapping and validator
defect.verification: editor path: Travel and finance fixtures invalid before the fix, valid after; all 26 EDMX corpus services valid after
